Sorting works in all four modes, keeps working while you filter, and scales to the big collection. Open **http://maker:4001/?demo=many** and use the new **Sort** dropdown (top-right of the controls):

1. Switch between **Newest saved**, **Oldest saved**, **Title A–Z**, and **Title Z–A** — the list reorders each time.
2. Combine it with a filter: choose **Title A–Z**, then click the **To read** view — the order *and* the filter both apply together.

Decisions to check:
- The default order is **Newest saved** (a link you just kept sits at the top).
- Sorting **works together** with search, tags, and the read/finished view — changing the order never clears your filters.

**Does sorting cover what you need — those four orders and Newest as the default?**
